Wi-Fi Connectivity Issues: Ensure your smart device is within Wi-Fi range.
Check if your Wi-Fi password has changed.
Device Not Responding: Check if the device is plugged in and powered on.
Verify the device app is updated to the latest version.
Voice Command Problems: Speak clearly and close to the microphone.
Ensure your internet connection is stable.
Light Not Turning On: Check if the bulb is screwed in properly.
Verify the light switch is on.
Ensure the bulb is compatible with your smart home system.
Thermostat Not Changing Temperature: Check if the thermostat is in the correct mode (heating/cooling).
Ensure the HVAC system is powered on.
Smart Lock Malfunction: Ensure there are no obstructions to the bolt.
Speaker Not Playing Music: Verify music service is linked and active.
Sensor Not Detecting Activity: Ensure sensor is paired with the hub.
Automation Not Triggering: Ensure all devices involved are online.
Remote Access Not Working: Ensure mobile app has latest updates.
Firmware Update Failed: Ensure a stable internet connection during update.
Device Lagging or Slow Response: Consider upgrading router or internet plan.
Compatibility Issues: Verify device compatibility with your smart home ecosystem.
Check for firmware updates that might add compatibility.
Battery Draining Quickly: Adjust device settings to reduce power consumption.
Consider replacing the battery if old.
Device Resetting Randomly: Look for firmware bugs and update if available.
Notifications Not Working: Ensure device is online and functioning.
Device Pairing Issues: Ensure devices are in pairing mode.
Bring devices closer to the hub.
Restart both devices and try again.
High Energy Consumption: Adjust schedules and automation to conserve energy.
Data Storage Full: Upgrade to a larger storage plan.
Adjust recording settings such as lower resolution.
Overheating Device: Reduce workload such as continuous streaming.
Integration with Third-Party Services Fa: Ensure third-party app permissions are granted.

Motion Detection Too Sensitive.Solution: Adjust sensitivity settings in the device app.
Motion Detection Too Sensitive.Detail: Lower the sensitivity to reduce false alerts.

Motion Detection Not Sensitive Enough.Solution: Increase sensitivity settings in the device app.
Motion Detection Not Sensitive Enough.Detail: Higher sensitivity will detect more subtle movements.

Temperature Sensor Inaccurate.Solution: Calibrate the sensor through the device app if available.
Temperature Sensor Inaccurate.Detail: Ensure the sensor is not exposed to direct heat sources or drafts.

Humidity Sensor Inaccurate.Solution: Calibrate the sensor through the device app if available.
Humidity Sensor Inaccurate.Detail: Verify the sensor is not near sources of moisture or extreme dryness.

Water Leak Detector False Alarms.Solution: Check sensor placement for potential false alarm triggers.
Water Leak Detector False Alarms.Detail: Ensure sensor is not in an area prone to condensation or minor spills.

Water Leak Detector Not Alerting.Solution: Test the sensor with a small amount of water to confirm functionality.
Water Leak Detector Not Alerting.Detail: Check battery levels and connectivity to the smart home hub.

Door/Window Sensor Not Registering.Solution: Adjust the magnet and sensor alignment.
Door/Window Sensor Not Registering.Detail: Ensure the gap between the magnet and sensor is within specified limits.

Door/Window Sensor False Alerts.Solution: Check for vibrations or loose mounting of the sensor.
Door/Window Sensor False Alerts.Detail: Ensure the sensor and magnet are firmly attached to the door/window frame.

Smoke Detector False Alarms.Solution: Clean the smoke detector to remove dust and debris.
Smoke Detector False Alarms.Detail: Ensure proper placement away from kitchens or high-humidity areas.

Smoke Detector Not Alerting.Solution: Test the smoke detector using its test button.
Smoke Detector Not Alerting.Detail: Check battery levels and ensure it is connected to the smart home system.
